title: Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge Calculation
content:
**Final inspection charge on an Appraisal Order — how the figure is reached.**

1. *Scope.* A value subject to completion or repairs needs a Form 1004D completion inspection before funding; that completion visit is charged under this rule when the report is inside its validity days at the closing date currently scheduled on the loan file, while a report past its validity days has its completion certified in the combined visit charged under the update visit charge or, past its maximum age with an update, is replaced by a new order; an order whose value is not subject to completion is charged nothing under this rule.
2. *Report age.* The report's age is counted in calendar days from the inspection date on the Appraisal Order to the closing date currently scheduled on the Mortgage Loan File; a report whose age equals the validity days is inside them.
3. *HPML flip.* An order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal is never charged a completion visit.
4. *Amount.* The standard final inspection charge is the report type's reinspection fee, charged once for the visit and paid in full by the borrower, that is 100 percent of it.
5. *Precision.* The charge is kept to the cent.

### Worked cases (hypothetical: report type with 120 validity days and a 175.00 reinspection fee)

| Value subject to completion | Report age at the scheduled closing date | HPML flip second appraisal | Final inspection charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 90 days | No | 175.00 |
| Yes | 120 days | No | 175.00 |
| Yes | 121 days | No | Not charged under this rule — completion is certified in the combined update visit, or the report is replaced by a new order past its maximum age with an update |
| No | 90 days | No | 0.00 |
| Yes | 90 days | Yes | 0.00 |
